unit_note: USD millions. Pages 25-26, Table 6 Schedule C, Borrowing from the US Treasury: Health and Human Services, Homeland Security, Housing and Urban Development, and Interior. All 13 printed lines are kept and each shows balances only: This Month and Fiscal Year to Date print dots or (**) on every line. No roll-forward applies, and the column total that adds these lines (Total Borrowing from the US Treasury, p26) spans other unit files, so this file declares no sum.
